summary: Planban 1.0.2 makes verified service and board URL resolution authoritative while treating Codex in-app browser opening as an optional bounded adapter.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban, verify the plugin and MCP tools are available, then confirm /pb returns a verified board link whether or not automatic in-app opening is available.
changelogSummary: Planban now preserves a verified board URL across Browser runtime setup, tab, navigation, and timeout failures while keeping automatic in-app opening when supported.
